comment: Stored floors for TestSearchQuality (NSO-568). Per ranker: mrr, ndcg10 and recall5 must not drop below these values, noAnswerMeanResults must not rise above. Values are the measured ones truncated to four decimals. Raise them when a ranker gets better, lower them only with a reason in the pull request. See docs/search-quality.md. scan is the default ranker (BM25F since NSO-577, with Czech word forms and the relaxed AND since NSO-578); legacy is the hand-tuned ranker it replaced, kept at its NSO-568 values until it is removed.
